{{Quote|There's a large-scale civil war on Balith. They've requested our assistance. Anakin, you will leave immediately to command the Third Legion.|Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="AS" />}}
By [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Assassin Date" /> a '''civil war''' had erupted on<ref name="AS" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Balith/Legends|Balith]] in the midst of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="AS" /> which transformed the planet into a war-torn world.<ref name="IVV">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref> When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] assistance in the large-scale conflict was requested, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]]<ref name="AS" /> and the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[unit]] [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]]<ref name="IVV" /> were dispatched by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to Balith to [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Third Legion/Legends|Third Legion]].<ref name="AS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The civil war was first mentioned in "[[Assassin (episode)|Assassin]],"<ref name="AS" /> the seventh episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', which aired on [[October 22]], [[2010]].<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Assassin">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode307.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Assassin}}</ref>
